reviewer: Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5); one fresh-context medium correctness reviewer

claims.summary: Characteristic zero, N>=3. On the open one-double-root stratum (a1=a2=A, other roots distinct) the fibre of C_N^+ is the cokernel of the Taylor matrix at T=0 of the confluent pair space spanned by f_ik=((1+a_iT)(1+a_kT))^(-3/2), f_Ak, g_k=T(1+AT)^(-5/2)(1+a_kT)^(-3/2) and (1+AT)^(-3); these R functions are independent and the Moebius flow acts by translation in T. If at one configuration with nonzero entries the space has no finite non-branch point of weight >=3 and the local-exponent minimal multiplicities at the branch values and at infinity are attained, then no height-two prime of Supp C_N^+ contained in the collision divisor meets its open one-double-root stratum.
claims.assessment: Working proof after one fresh-context medium review; the flow reduces codimension one inside the stratum to a generic property, and a Hurwitz escape argument using the minimal branch and infinity multiplicities lets a single point certify it.
claims.rationale: Clears the collision divisor from the first-step codimension obligation of open statement 3, up to one single-point check per N.

claims.summary: Deterministic exact certificates at N=5,6,7 (double root 1; simple roots 2,3,-1 / 2,3,-1,5 / 2,3,5,-1,-4): the cleared confluent Wronskian polynomial, computed mod 2^61-1 by exact interpolation, has degree 93/319/845 and branch multiplicities 15,21 / 39,55 / 85,120, all equal to the local-exponent minima, and its non-branch part is squarefree; by p-adic multiplicity bookkeeping the hypotheses of the confluent weight criterion hold in characteristic zero.
claims.assessment: Finite check, exact and deterministic: one configuration per N, reduction of a Z[1/2]-polynomial of bounded degree, with degree and branch multiplicities matching proved lower bounds.
claims.rationale: Supplies the hypothesis of the confluent weight criterion at N=7, the first size of open statement 3; N=5,6 are controls.

claims.summary: L_7 = ker(C_7^+ -> D22(-4)) has no height-two component inside the collision divisor; with the seven-root off-collision corollary, alpha_7 = lambda_7 = 105 holds if the non-collision Wronskian discriminant is squarefree at N=7.
claims.assessment: Working proof of the collision exclusion from the confluent weight criterion, its N=7 certificate and the invariant-prefix theorem; the equality alpha_7=105 remains conditional on the randomized off-collision certificate.
claims.rationale: Reduces the first open size of statement 3 to a single off-collision squarefreeness input.
claims.next_action: Make the seven-root discriminant certificate deterministic.

relationships: Fibre of C_N^+ via the pair-column span.
Excludes the double-pair and triple-root closures.
Together they reduce alpha_7=lambda_7 to off-collision squarefreeness.
